DbError.GenericText: Please try again. If it keeps happening, the database may be down: make sure the MySQL server is running.

unreachable.title: Can't connect to the database
unreachable.text: The program can't reach the database server (MySQL). It's most likely stopped.
steps: Start MySQL: in XAMPP click Start next to MySQL, or use WAMP / Laragon, or start the MySQL service from Windows services (services.msc).
If MySQL is running: open .env and check DATABASE_URL (try 127.0.0.1 instead of localhost and check port 3306).

auth.title: Wrong database username or password
auth.text: MySQL is running but rejected the username or password in .env.
steps: Open .env and check the username and password in DATABASE_URL.
Special characters in the password (like @ or #) must be URL-encoded (e.g. @ becomes %40).
Save, restart npm run dev, then click "Try again".

notFound.title: Database not found
notFound.text: MySQL is running but the database name in .env doesn't exist.
steps: Check the database name at the end of DATABASE_URL in .env.
If it's a new database: create it (phpMyAdmin or any tool), then run npm run db:deploy.

schema.title: The database needs an update
schema.text: The program has new tables or columns that haven't been added to the database yet.
steps: Run: npm run db:deploy (adds the new parts only; your data stays).
Start npm run dev again and click "Try again".

Promotions.RulesHint: Running promotions apply automatically in POS, sales invoices and quotations. An item with several promotions gets the best one for the customer, and the invoice-total promotion applies on top of item discounts.

Zatca.Title: ZATCA Integration
Zatca.MissingData: Missing or invalid data must be completed before onboarding
Zatca.OfflineHint: The service starts automatically with the app. If it didn't, press "Start service"
Zatca.TestPassed: Service OK: build, signing and validation passed
Zatca.PerBranchHint: Each branch is onboarded with ZATCA as a separate unit (EGS) with its own certificate. Start with the developer portal for testing, then onboard to production.
Zatca.CommonNameHint: A unique unit name in English letters and digits without symbols, e.g. ERP-BR1
Zatca.OrganizationUnitHint: Branch name. For VAT groups: the member's 10-digit TIN
Zatca.LocationHint: City or short address of the branch
Zatca.CsrHint: We'll create a certificate request (CSR) and private key for this branch. The key is stored encrypted and never leaves the server.
Zatca.ChecksFailed: Some documents were rejected, check the messages
Zatca.ChecksHint: The system sends ZATCA a test document of each required type and shows each result. For branches issuing both kinds: 6 documents (standard invoice, standard credit note, standard debit note, simplified invoice, simplified credit note, simplified debit note).
Zatca.ProductionHint: Final step: request the production certificate (CSID). The branch will then be ready to send invoices on this environment.
Zatca.ResetConfirmText: The CSR, key and certificates will be deleted and the branch must be onboarded again (production needs a new OTP from Fatoora).
Zatca.ResetHint: To change the environment or data after onboarding

envHint.developer: Developer sandbox: any 6-digit OTP works and invoices are not official.
envHint.simulation: Simulation: a production-like environment for testing; get the OTP from the Fatoora simulation portal.
envHint.production: Production: official onboarding; every submitted invoice is recorded by ZATCA. Get the OTP from the Fatoora portal.

otpHint.developer: The developer portal accepts any 6 digits, e.g. 123345
otpHint.simulation: Open the Fatoora portal (simulation) → onboard new solution unit → copy the OTP (valid for one hour)
otpHint.production: Open fatoora.zatca.gov.sa → onboard new solution unit → copy the OTP (valid for one hour)

activeHint.developer: Branch is onboarded on the developer portal for testing
activeHint.production: Branch is officially onboarded on production

missing.taxNo: VAT number (15 digits starting and ending with 3)

Zatca.MasterKeyFileHint: Certificates and private keys are encrypted with a key stored in the .zatca folder next to the app. Back it up with every database backup; if it's lost, branches must be onboarded again.
Zatca.StartingHint: The service starts automatically (the first time may take a minute to build)

gatewayError.KeyMismatch: Another copy of the service is running with a different key (probably started manually). Close it and press Start service
gatewayError.DotnetMissing: .NET 8 is not installed. Install the .NET 8 SDK from Microsoft and restart the app
gatewayError.PublishFailed: Building the service failed (check [zatca-gateway] messages in the app console)
gatewayError.StartFailed: The service didn't start (check [zatca-gateway] messages in the app console)

Zatca.B2BIncomplete: Customer {name} is a business (standard tax invoice) with incomplete data
Zatca.AskAdminToComplete: Ask an admin to complete the customer's data (edit customers permission)
Zatca.SendOnSaveHint: Invoices are always signed on save. If off, simplified invoices are sent later (automatically or from monitoring). Standard invoices are cleared on save anyway

result.sending: Invoice signed and being sent in the background
result.standardNotCleared: The standard invoice is not cleared yet; don't hand it to the customer before clearance
result.pending: Invoice signed; it will be sent later
result.unsigned: Invoice saved but not signed (service down); it will be signed automatically once the service is up
result.error: Sending failed (connection); it will be retried automatically

Zatca.LockedText: Signed invoices can't be edited or deleted. To fix a mistake, issue a return (credit note) and a new invoice
Zatca.UnsignedHint: The invoice isn't signed yet (service was down). It will be signed automatically, or press Sign & send
Zatca.StandardNotClearedHint: Standard invoice not cleared by ZATCA yet: don't hand it over or print it before clearance
Zatca.QueueBusy: A send is already running, try again shortly
Zatca.UnsignedCount: {count} invoices are not signed (service was down) and will be signed automatically
Zatca.EodText: {count} invoices haven't been sent to ZATCA yet. Simplified invoices must be reported within 24 hours. Open monitoring and press Send all pending
Zatca.AutoSendHint: Unsent invoices are sent in the background periodically
Zatca.AlertTimeHint: After this time an alert shows if invoices are still unsent

DataReset.Title: Data reset
DataReset.BackupHint: Back up the database before resetting.

hint.sales: With their payments and stock movements. Converted quotations become open again; vouchers paid against them stay as customer credit
hint.saleReturns: With payments and movements; original invoices become unreturned
hint.purchases: With their payments and stock movements
hint.purchaseReturns: With payments and movements; original invoices become unreturned
hint.vouchers: All vouchers; remaining invoices lose voucher settlements
hint.shifts: Shifts and drawer cash in/out. Remaining invoices and vouchers stay without a shift
hint.transfers: Transfers between warehouses and their movements
hint.counts: Count documents and their stock adjustments
hint.openingStock: Opening stock in the product screen becomes zero
hint.products: With their units, prices and balances
hint.priceLists: Price lists and their prices (branches return to normal prices)
hint.openingBalances: Opening balance of customers and suppliers becomes zero (they are kept)

DataReset.BlockedProduction: Blocked: invoices were sent to ZATCA production

protectedHint.company: Name, VAT number, address and logo
protectedHint.printing: Invoice, receipt and barcode label layouts
protectedHint.zatca: Units, certificates, invoice chain and sending settings
protectedHint.loginSecurity: Login settings, login log, signed-in devices and locks
protectedHint.users: So you can still sign in after the reset

DataReset.KeepNote: Settings are changed from the settings screens, not by reset.
DataReset.ResetNumbersHint: Only for deleted types. Types that still have documents keep numbering so numbers never repeat
DataReset.ProductionLiveTitle: Invoices were already sent to ZATCA production
DataReset.ProductionLiveText: {docs} invoice(s) were sent to ZATCA production, so all sales invoices and returns are locked from reset, along with anything that must be deleted with them (products, customers, categories, units). These are official records; corrections are made with a return (credit note). Other types can still be reset.

Backup.Title: Backup
Backup.FolderHint: Backups are saved on the machine running the app (the server). Prefer a folder on another drive or USB disk, and download a copy to your device with the download button.
Backup.RestoreHint: You can restore any backup manually with this command on the server from the file's folder (it asks for the database password):
Backup.BrowseHint: These are the folders on the machine running the program (the server). Expand any drive or folder with the arrow, pick a shortcut, or paste a path above and press Enter.
Backup.NotWritable: The program cannot write to this folder; choose another one
Backup.AutoEnableHint: The program takes a backup by itself on schedule and saves it in the backup folder above.
Backup.KeepHint: Older ones are deleted automatically (manual backups are never touched)
Backup.AutoNote: Automatic backup runs while the program is running. If the machine was off at the scheduled time, the missed backup is taken as soon as the program starts. If a backup fails, it retries every 30 minutes.
Backup.LastAutoFailed: The last automatic backup failed (retrying every 30 minutes)
Backup.Uploaded: File uploaded, you can restore it from the table
Backup.RestoreWarn1: All current data will be replaced by this backup; anything done after the backup time will be lost.
Backup.RestoreWarn2: A safety backup of the current state is taken first, so you can go back if needed.
Backup.RestoreWarn3: Nothing can be saved during the restore, and afterwards all users are signed out (including you).
Backup.RestoreWarn4: ZATCA: the invoice counter will not go back; it continues from the last sent number so numbers are never repeated.
Backup.RestoreRunning: Restoring... do not close the page. It can take a few minutes depending on data size.
Backup.RestoreDoneText: Data is back as it was at the backup time. Safety backup (state before the restore): {safety}
Backup.RestoreMigrated: The backup was older than the program; {count} database update(s) were applied automatically.
Backup.RestoreMigrateFailed: The backup is older than the program and the automatic database update failed: run npm run db:deploy on the server, then restart the program.
Backup.RestoreZatcaGap: ZATCA notice: {count} invoice(s) were sent to production after the backup time and are not in the restored data. The counter continues after them.
Backup.RestoreManualTitle: If the program itself is not running

Security.Title: Login & security
Security.SumLock: After {attempts} wrong within {window}, sign-in with that name is locked for {lock}.
Security.SumProgressive: Repeated failures after a lock make the lock longer.
Security.SumNoLock: No lock after wrong attempts (not recommended).
Security.SumIp: If one device makes {attempts} wrong (any names), that device is locked for {lock}.
Security.SumSession: A session ends {time} after sign-in; then the user must sign in again.
Security.SumBrowserClose: Closing the browser signs out immediately.
Security.SumIdle: If the device is idle for {time}, it signs out automatically (with a one-minute warning).
Security.SumDevicesOldest: Each user may use {devices} at a time; signing in on another device signs out the oldest one.
Security.SumDevicesReject: Each user may use {devices} at a time; signing in on another device is refused.
Security.MaxAttemptsHint: Per username, even if the name does not exist (so valid names cannot be guessed)
Security.AttemptWindowHint: After this time from the first wrong attempt, the counter restarts
Security.IpMaxAttempts: Lock device (IP) after wrong attempts with any names
Security.IpMaxAttemptsHint: Stops someone trying many names from one device. Note: all devices in a shop usually share one IP, so keep this number high
Security.ShowRemainingHint: The error message tells how many attempts are left before the lock
Security.SessionHoursHint: After this the user must sign in again even if active. Also applies to devices signed in now
Security.IdleMinutesHint: No mouse, keyboard or touch for this long signs out automatically, with a warning one minute before
Security.BrowserClose: Sign out when the browser closes
Security.BrowserCloseHint: Reopening the browser shows the login page (applies from the next sign-in)
Security.MaxDevices: Devices allowed per user at the same time
Security.MaxDevicesHint: For example 1: a cashier cannot use the same account on two devices (applies from the next sign-in)
Security.DeviceMode: When signing in on one device too many

modeHint.oldest: The new sign-in continues and the least recently active device is signed out
modeHint.reject: The user must sign out on another device first, or a manager signs it out from Signed-in devices

Security.SkipSuper: System admin is excluded from the device limit
Security.SkipSuperHint: So the admin can use a computer and a phone together
Security.EndSessionConfirm: Sign out this device? It will return to the login page
Security.LogTruncated: Only the latest 3000 attempts are shown. Narrow the period or pick a user.
Security.UnlockConfirm: Unlock? They can try to sign in again right away
Security.IdleWarnTitle: You are about to be signed out
Security.IdleWarnText: There has been no activity for a while. You will be signed out automatically in (seconds):

OwnerAccount.Title: Owner account
OwnerAccount.Hint: These details are saved in the settings file on the server (.env) and apply immediately. Nobody else can see this screen.
OwnerAccount.NameHint: The name shown at the top and on any document you create yourself (e.g. Support)
OwnerAccount.NewPasswordHint: Leave empty to keep it (at least 8 characters)

Connection.KeepData: What is on the screen is kept, and you will continue where you left off once the connection is back.

offline.title: No internet connection
offline.text: This device is not connected to the internet right now, so nothing can be saved or loaded.
tips: Make sure Wi-Fi or the network cable is connected.
Try opening another website to check the internet.
If you use a router, restart it.

server.title: Server problem
server.text: Your internet is working, but the program's server is not responding right now.
tips: Wait a minute and try again; the server may be updating or restarting.
If the problem continues, contact support.

db.title: Database problem
db.text: The server is running, but the database is not responding right now.
tips: Wait a minute and try again.
If the problem continues, contact support (MySQL must be running on the server).
